templates.title: Net Worth Certificate
templates.subtitle: Audited Statement of Assets & Liabilities for Bank Credit / Visa
templates.description: Certified computation of individual or corporate net worth based on verified books, property valuations, and bank balances.
templates.defaultPurpose: Submission to Scheduled Commercial Bank for credit facility appraisal.

fields.label: As on Date
fields.hint: Valuation and balance sheet cutoff date

fields.label: Immovable Properties (₹ in Lakhs)
fields.hint: Market valuation of lands, commercial offices, or residential flats

fields.label: Movable & Liquid Assets (₹ in Lakhs)
fields.hint: Bank FDs, Mutual Funds, Listed Equities & Cash balances

fields.label: Capital in Business / Firms (₹ in Lakhs)
fields.hint: Partner capital or audited equity holdings

fields.label: Total Secured & Unsecured Liabilities (₹ in Lakhs)
fields.hint: Term loans, mortgages, overdrafts, and personal borrowings

fields.label: Addressed To / Bank Name
fields.defaultValue: State Bank of India / HDFC Bank Limited
fields.hint: Specific bank branch or general whomsoever notice

templates.title: Turnover & Revenue Certificate
templates.subtitle: Multi-Year Audited Financial Turnover for Tenders & Empanelment
templates.description: Certifies past 3 financial years annual turnover from operations extracted from audited financial statements and GSTR-9 annual returns.
templates.defaultPurpose: Submission for Government / PSU Technical Tender Qualification.

fields.label: Tender / Authority Reference
fields.defaultValue: National Highway Authority of India (NHAI) Tender No. 441/2026

templates.title: Form 15CB Foreign Remittance Certificate
templates.subtitle: Section 195 Tax Withholding Certificate for Outward Remittances
templates.description: Mandatory certificate by an Accountant for overseas payments under Income-tax Act, 1961 assessing DTAA and withholding tax rate.
templates.defaultPurpose: Remittance to foreign entity via Authorised Dealer Bank.

fields.label: Nature of Remittance
fields.defaultValue: Fees for Technical & Engineering Design Services (FTS)

fields.label: Applicable TDS Rate under DTAA / IT Act (%)
Authorised Dealer (AD) Bank & Branch
fields.defaultValue: State Bank of India, Overseas Branch, Mumbai

templates.title: Working Capital & Bank Finance Certificate
templates.subtitle: Certification of Current Assets, Current Liabilities & Margin Requirements
templates.description: Assessment of Working Capital limits (Cash Credit / Overdraft) based on inventory holding, debtors cycle, and Maximum Permissible Bank Finance (MPBF).
templates.defaultPurpose: Sanction and renewal of Cash Credit / Working Capital Limits.

fields.label: Trade Debtors / Receivables (< 90 Days) (₹ in Lakhs)
Trade Creditors / Sundry Payables (₹ in Lakhs)
Existing Sanctioned CC Limit (₹ in Lakhs)

templates.title: Statutory Compliance & GST Clearance Certificate
templates.subtitle: Confirmation of timely filing of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B & Income Tax Dues
templates.description: Certifies that the party has filed all periodic statutory GST and Direct Tax returns without undisputed outstanding government demands.
templates.defaultPurpose: Vendor registration and quarterly statutory compliance verification.

fields.label: GST Returns Filing Status
fields.defaultValue: All GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B returns filed up to recent preceding month

fields.label: Undisputed Tax Demands / Arrears
fields.defaultValue: NIL as per GST portal & Income Tax e-filing portal records
